name: CardName
definition: The printed name of a Magic card.

name: Language
definition: The language of a card printing.

name: Format
definition: A play format a card legality record refers to.

name: LegalityStatus
definition: The legality status of a card in a given format.

name: FlavorText
definition: The flavor text printed on a card.

name: SetCode
definition: The short code identifying a card set.

name: SetName
definition: The full name of a card set.

name: Block
definition: The block a card set belongs to.

name: MTGOAvailability
definition: Whether a card set is available on Magic: The Gathering Online.
scope: tab04 where fld089 IS NOT NULL
aliases: appear on Magic: The Gathering Online

name: BannedCardCount
definition: Number of card printings that are banned in a format. Formula: COUNT(LegalityStatus = 'Banned'). Inputs: LegalityStatus = tab03.fld077

name: PortugueseCommanderBlockSetCount
definition: Number of sets in the Commander block that have Brazilian Portuguese translations. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT SetCode WHERE Block = 'Commander' AND Language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)'). Inputs: Block = tab04.fld079; Language = tab02.fld075; SetCode = tab05.fld063
aliases: Brazilian Portuguese translated sets in Commander block
count of Portuguese sets in Commander block

name: CardLanguage
definition: Which languages a card printing is available in.

name: CardSetBlock
definition: The block grouping a card set belongs to.
